name: Shopify app subscription (for enterprises)
notes: Enterprise variant targets high-volume merchants needing custom logic, ERP sync, or multi-store management. Proxy TIER0 via GitHub Search for enterprise-grade Shopify Plus apps. Official targets: Shopify Plus Partner Program + GraphQL Admin API. Monetization via usage-based or tiered enterprise pricing. Zero-capital PoC uses dev store + mock data; production requires Plus partner status (free application).
